available_source: The owned source directory contained the verified Git Town archive files but had no Git Town .git metadata; git resolved upward to the Playtestr worktree at 762a8b3a558a42b7389b207be42ccc5a4215d5d5.

first_helper_attempt.result: Go build VCS inspection failed with exit status 128 before a Git Town executable was created or launched.

guarded_retry.result: Prelaunch refusal after verifying the source archive hash and complete pinned file manifest; the parent Playtestr Git worktree was not accepted as Git Town provenance.

additional_local_attempts.result: The first baseline invocation rejected an undeclared evidence phase before starting the Playtestr runner or Git Town.
The helper next rejected a duplicate immutable build-receipt path before any target launch.
The stale local runtime receipt rejected a rebuilt binary whose hash differed; the target did not launch.
A second stale-runtime mismatch was retained after the helper moved fault binaries to separate owned paths.

The runner launched but Windows workspace setup returned workspace_setup_failure: expand native workspace path: Access is denied. The Git Town scenario command did not launch; workspace cleanup was not attempted because setup never completed. A separate bounded --version probe had already completed during build verification.

local_binary_recovery.disposition: The original runtime/build receipts were copied byte-for-byte before updating the ignored local runtime pointer to a rebuilt executable from the verified pinned archive. No fault mutation was applied. The rebuilt executable, runtime receipt and build receipt hashes are recorded in the recovery receipt.

resolution: Fault helper now accepts either an exact clean pinned Git checkout or a complete source-archive materialization verified against every provenance hash and the archive digest. Archive builds explicitly disable Go VCS stamping. Hosted jobs require the pinned checkout.
